rows.ja: 供給元(製造・部品・クラウド)

relations.text: Fortinetは、セキュリティ機器の製造をWistronなどの受託製造・設計製造パートナーに委託している
relations.text_en: Fortinet outsources manufacturing of its security appliances to contract and original design manufacturing partners including Wistron

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: We outsource the manufacturing of our security appliance products to contract manufacturing partners and original design manufacturing partners, including manufacturers with facilities located in Taiwan and other countries outside the United States such as Accton, IBASE, Micro-Star, Senao and Wistron.

relations.text: WistronはFortinetの製造パートナーの1社として挙げられている
relations.text_en: Wistron is named among Fortinet’s manufacturers

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: (“Senao”), Wistron Corporation (“Wistron”), and a number of other manufacturers.

relations.text: Fortinet独自のASICは、Toshiba America Electronic Componentsなどの受託製造会社が製造している
relations.text_en: Fortinet’s proprietary ASICs are built by contract manufacturers including Toshiba America Electronic Components, Inc.

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Our proprietary ASICs, which are key to the performance of our appliances, are built by contract manufacturers including Toshiba America Electronic Components, Inc.
source.note: 子会社名義の記載です。

relations.text: 機器向けの限定調達部品として、Toshibaのメモリ素子が挙げられている
relations.text_en: Toshiba is listed as a supplier of memory devices among limited-source components

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Our limited source components for particular appliances and suppliers of those components include specific types of CPUs from Intel and AMD, network and wireless chips from Broadcom, Marvell, Qualcomm and Intel, and memory devices from Intel, Micron, ADATA, Toshiba, Samsung and Western Digital.

relations.text: 機器向けの限定調達部品として、Western Digitalのメモリ素子が挙げられている
relations.text_en: Western Digital is listed as a supplier of memory devices among limited-source components

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Our limited source components for particular appliances and suppliers of those components include specific types of CPUs from Intel and AMD, network and wireless chips from Broadcom, Marvell, Qualcomm and Intel, and memory devices from Intel, Micron, ADATA, Toshiba, Samsung and Western Digital.

relations.text: Fortinetの受託製造会社は、TSMCなどが運営する台湾・日本のファウンドリを使っている
relations.text_en: Fortinet’s contract manufacturers use foundries in Taiwan and Japan operated by TSMC

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: These contract manufacturers use foundries in Taiwan and Japan operated by either Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (“TSMC”) or by the contract manufacturer itself.
source.note: 受託製造会社を介した間接的な関係です。

relations.text: Fortinetは、Amazon Web Servicesなどのパブリッククラウドに依存している
relations.text_en: Fortinet relies on public cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: We rely on public cloud providers, such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud colocation providers, such as Equinix, and our own data centers and PoPs, and any availability interruption in any of these cloud solutions could result in us not meeting our service-level commitments to our customers.

companies.name: アロー・エレクトロニクス

relations.text: FortinetはArrow Electronicsなどの技術流通企業と協業している
relations.text_en: Fortinet works with technology distributors including Arrow Electronics, Inc.

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: We work with many technology distributors, including Arrow Electronics, Inc., Exclusive, Ingram Micro, and TD Synnex.

relations.text: FortinetはIntelと、Fortinet Security Processor 6 (SP6)を開発する戦略的協業を発表した
relations.text_en: Fortinet announced a strategic collaboration with Intel to develop Fortinet Security Processor 6 (SP6)

source.label: Fortinet 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced a strategic collaboration with Intel to develop Fortinet Security Processor 6 (SP6), combining Fortinet’s proprietary, purpose-built security processor expertise with Intel’s advanced design, development,

relations.text: FortinetはNVIDIAと、BlueField-3 DPU上でFortiGate VMを動かす統合ソリューションを発表した
relations.text_en: Fortinet announced an integrated solution with NVIDIA embedding FortiGate VM on BlueField-3 DPUs

source.label: Fortinet 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced an integrated solution with NVIDIA that delivers isolated infrastructure acceleration for the AI Factory, embedding FortiGate VM on BlueField-3 DPUs to provide firewalling, segmentation and policy enforcement directly in the infrastructure for higher performance, stronger isolation and simpler operations.

relations.text: FortinetはNVIDIAのOpen Secure AI Allianceの創設メンバーである
relations.text_en: Fortinet is a founding member of NVIDIA’s Open Secure AI Alliance

source.label: Fortinet 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Partnered with Anthropic on Project Glasswing (Mythos), OpenAI on Project Daybreak (GPT 5.5 Cyber), and NVIDIA as a founding member of its recently announced Open Secure AI Alliance for AI Safety and Security.

relations.text: FortinetはGoogle Unified Security Recommendedの、ネットワーク保護分野の初のパートナーに選ばれた
relations.text_en: Fortinet was named the inaugural Google Unified Security Recommended partner for network protection

source.label: Fortinet 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Named the inaugural Google Unified Security Recommended partner for network protection, recognizing FortiSASE and FortiGate NGFW for delivering converged networking and security natively on Google Cloud.

relations.text: FortinetはAnthropicと「Project Glasswing」の一環で協業している
relations.text_en: Fortinet is collaborating with Anthropic as part of “Project Glasswing”

source.label: Fortinet 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Fortinet is collaborating closely with multiple leading AI companies, including Anthropic as part of “Project Glasswing”, OpenAI and others.

relations.text: FortinetはOpenAIなどのAI企業と緊密に協業している
relations.text_en: Fortinet is collaborating closely with AI companies including OpenAI

source.label: Fortinet 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Fortinet is collaborating closely with multiple leading AI companies, including Anthropic as part of “Project Glasswing”, OpenAI and others.
